title: Joining a Gym for the First Time in NZ — What to Expect and How to Choose
meta_desc: Learn what to expect when joining a gym for the first time in NZ, from trial passes and inductions to contracts and the best starter gyms.
intro: Your first gym membership can feel overwhelming – there are dozens of chains, hidden fees, and a flood of promotional offers. This guide cuts through the noise with real prices and practical tips.

sections.heading: What to Look for in Your First Gym
list: Location and opening hours – 24/7 access is common, but a gym near home or work saves commute time.
Equipment mix – enough free weights, cardio machines, and functional zones for beginners.
Class variety – introductory HIIT, yoga, or strength classes help build confidence.
Cleanliness and staff friendliness – a welcoming environment reduces intimidation.
Additional amenities – showers, lockers, and parking can affect your overall cost.

sections.heading: Trial Passes – Test Before You Commit
list: 7‑day free passes are standard at Les Mills, Anytime Fitness and Jetts.
3‑day $5 passes at Snap Fitness Auckland City – great for a quick feel.
No‑card required trial at Fitness First Wellington; just bring ID.
Ask about “bring a friend” days – you get two passes for the price of one.

sections.heading: Induction Sessions – Getting Started Safely
sections.body: Most NZ gyms include a free induction session with a qualified trainer. Expect a 30‑minute walkthrough of equipment, a basic movement screen, and a starter workout plan tailored to your goals. Bring your own shoes and a water bottle; the session is your chance to ask about class schedules and injury‑prevention tips.

sections.heading: Best Starter Gyms for Newbies
list: Les Mills – low joining fee, strong beginner class schedule, 7‑day free trial.
Jetts – affordable $15 week contract, 24/7 access, free induction.
Anytime Fitness – nationwide key card, good cardio area, frequent promotional discounts.
Snap Fitness – friendly staff, plenty of free weights, $5‑day trial for first‑timers.
